name: 28271-imageprefill-qwen25vl7b-4gpu
hardware: 4x H100 80GB HBM3, four GPUs of one a3 node, NVSwitch-connected (--gres=gpu:4).
parallelism: TP=4, PP=1, DP=1; one vLLM engine, served in-process through guidellm's vllm_python backend.
architecture: Qwen2_5_VLForConditionalGeneration, 8.29B params bf16 (~16.6 GB); 28-layer decoder plus a 32-block native-resolution ViT, per the checkpoint's own config.json.
load_profile: constant (open loop), rate 3.0 req/s, warmup 20%, cooldown 10%, bounded at 600 requests with a 900 s safety cap, static seed 28271.
workload: single-turn image chat -- one 1288x1288 jpeg image plus a 24-token text prompt, 8 output tokens, temperature 0.0. Synthesised by guidellm from two --data sources: synthetic_text (prompt_tokens and output_tokens pinned min=max) and synthetic_image (1288x1288, 1 image per request, jpeg quality 85, gradient content).
purpose: A photo question-answering assistant returning brief answers for one large image per request, three requests per second, four GPUs.
launch:
model: Qwen/Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct
tensor-parallel-size: 4
dtype: bfloat16
max-model-len: 4096
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90
